acceptance_criteria: Implement a deterministic LangGraph workflow in src/agent.py with a callable run(task) returning exactly Echo: <task> for a non-empty string.
Reject non-string and whitespace-only inputs with ValueError; preserve the original non-empty task text.
Tests prove normal, Unicode, whitespace preservation and invalid inputs. No model calls or external tools.
Do not modify approved agent.json, Factory control artifacts, permissions or lifecycle state. Leave the package staged and unpromoted.
stop_conditions: Stop on ambiguity, exhausted token/time allowance, unknown usage, invalid output, failed tests or any write outside the permitted paths.
No retries with uncertain spend, fallback backend, budget increase, promotion or registry changes.
runtime_pattern_reason: One fixed validation-and-echo path needs no model planning or tool choice.
